answer: Histories are stored in echo, checked in gale, and canyon shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 1 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1194 identities would post 705 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
